description: Returns a database user name and temporary password with temporary authorization to log on to an Amazon Redshift database.

incidents.description: From CI/CD to Cloud Data: How Shai Hulud Persistence Leads to Redshift Breach

securityImplications: Attackers might use GetClusterCredentials to mint temporary database credentials for an Amazon Redshift cluster through IAM authentication, giving them direct login access to the data warehouse.
